# Lab results

**Since the reorientation of October 8, 2026**, the reference is the [results ledger](../ledger/results-ledger.json), generated by `pnpm lab import`. For each run it gives its role, its validity class (A contract, B relative same host, C absolute), its decisions and whether it needs a rerun. Verdicts and quantified reports will be generated from the data (phase P4). The scripts `analyze-integrated.mjs`, `audit-integrated.py`, `render-integrated.py` and `update-integrated-index.py` are **legacy**: kept to reproduce the reports of October 7 and 8, but they contain hand-written counts and wording. They no longer serve as the basis for a decision.

Read first the [results of the durable workflow and shared SQLite, October 8](workflow-2026-10-08.md), then the [qualification and architecture report](qualification-2026-10-07.md), then the [HTML index of experiments](index.html).

`evidence/` keeps a dated selection of reports, manifests, summaries and raw attempts. These copies document past experiments; they are not silently regenerated when an adapter changes. The SQLite/JSON/JSONL files used as sinks remain in the unique folders under `lab/results/`, whose local links are given by the index.

The first construction experiments remain in `lab/results/`. Some detected lab bugs or predated the standardization of viewports, imports and configuration. They are not used to draw conclusions about final performance.

The controlled data are not a representative corpus of all sites. The results remain exploratory; the acknowledgment/durability scopes and the lifecycles must be read together with the figures. Repeat on a dedicated machine and an independent corpus before any comparative publication or architecture adoption.

`evidence-2026-10-08/` keeps five new campaigns with frozen sources and its own SHA-256 catalog; the October 7 `evidence/` archive is kept intact.
